647:t_002:10.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「As beings who advanced along the path of evolution before you, we have awaited the growth of Earthlings.」

647:t_002:11.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Those were difficult days for us as well. After all, higher-dimensional life-forms are forbidden from interfering with ordinary species.」

647:t_002:12.en:
$$桂$$
「What the hell kind of rule is that?」

647:t_002:13.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Those who will not walk the path of evolution themselves have no future... Evolution cannot be forced upon someone at another's urging.」

647:t_002:14.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「If we wielded our power too readily, our immature younger brothers would rely on it and cease walking on their own two feet.」

647:t_002:15.en:
$$弁慶$$
「It's true that $$ミケーネ$$ hasn't actively attacked humanity, but...」

647:t_002:16.en:
$$隼人$$
「But that was simply because they saw humanity as beneath their notice.」

647:t_002:17.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「And I haven't forgotten! You burned $$熱海$$!」

647:t_002:18.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「We did that deliberately to ignite your fighting spirit!」

647:t_002:19.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Yes! We deliberately became evil so that we might serve as your trial!」

647:t_002:20.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Come, younger brothers climbing the stairway of evolution! Give us your power!」

647:t_002:21.en:
$$スズネ$$
「It seems the only thing about you that evolved was your silver tongues.」

647:t_002:22.en:
$n
「Unfortunately, your brains seem to have been left behind. You're not convincing anyone.」

647:t_002:23.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「You...! You dare mock us gods?!」

647:t_002:24.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Such insolence from mere Earthlings will not be tolerated!」

647:t_002:25.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You're showing your true colors way too soon, $$ミケーネ$$!」

647:t_002:26.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$ and $n were right. Your evolution seems pretty damn lopsided.」

647:t_002:27.en:
$$万丈$$
「However many words you dress it up in, deep down, you look down on humanity.」

647:t_002:28.en:
$$甲児$$
「Don't think we'll fall for the smooth talk of scum like you!」

647:t_002:29.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Mere humans dare get above themselves!」

647:t_002:30.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「We intended to make you our vanguard in the True War, but we have lost all desire to do so! We shall dispose of you here!」

647:t_002:31.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「It seems we gods of $$オリュンポス$$ are not alone in thinking so!」

647:t_003:1.en:
$$グーラ$$
「Father and $$ズール$$ are after us too?!」

647:t_003:2.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「We cannot allow your four $$スフィア$$s to fall into the hands of the $$御使い$$s!」

647:t_003:3.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「And we cannot allow you to advance any farther!」

647:t_003:4.en:
$$タケル$$
「$$ミケーネ$$... and $$ズール$$ and the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$... We want to save Earth from danger and stop this universe from collapsing.」

647:t_003:5.en:
$$タケル$$
「That's why we're heading for the center of the galaxy. Can't you at least stop fighting until then?」

647:t_003:6.en:
$$超能力者$$
「Nonsense! It seems you have lost your nerve, $$マーズ$$!」

647:t_003:7.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Know your place! Neither our king, Lord $$ハーデス$$, nor $$皇帝ズール$$ and his allies have any intention of listening to your wishes!」

647:t_003:8.en:
$$超能力者$$
「We shall defeat you, seize Earth once its strength inevitably runs out, and use it as the power to destroy them!」

647:t_003:9.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「...It's a pity. There is no reasoning with you.」

647:t_003:10.en:
$$刹那$$
「We're exchanging words, yet I feel much farther from them than I did from the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$...」

647:t_003:11.en:
$$タケル$$
「$$刹那$$... There are some people in this world we can never understand.」

647:t_003:12.en:
$$タケル$$
「And if they intend to take away our peace and freedom...」

647:t_003:13.en:
$$甲児$$
「We won't hesitate to fight! That's our mission, as the ones who set out with Earth's fate on our shoulders!」

647:t_003:14.en:
$$號$$
「Gods of $$ミケーネ$$, and those enthralled by darkness! Learn the strength of Earthlings who believe in the future!」

647:t_003:15.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Let's go! You'll be our first prey out here in the galaxy!」

647:t_003:16.en:
$$タケル$$
「We'll keep going! To protect Earth... and this universe!」

647:t_004:0.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Be careful! The dimensional boundary is rapidly warping!」

647:t_004:2.en:
$$勝平$$
「Whatever comes, nothing's stopping us now!」

647:t_005:1.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「And there's a whole bunch of the bastards!」

647:t_005:2.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「I am $$コンピュータードール#pilot$$ No. 3...」

647:t_005:3.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「I am $$コンピュータードール#pilot$$ No. 10...」

647:t_005:4.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「I am $$コンピュータードール#pilot$$ No. 17...」

647:t_005:5.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「I am $$コンピュータードール#pilot$$ No. 22...」

647:t_005:6.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「I am $$コンピュータードール#pilot$$ No. 29...」

647:t_005:7.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「I am $$コンピュータードール#pilot$$ No. 36...」

647:t_005:8.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「Humanity, whose thoughts are evil. Have you finally ventured into the galactic sea?」

647:t_005:9.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「Our mission is to eliminate evil humanity.」

647:t_005:10.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「We shall carry out that mission.」

647:t_005:11.en:
$$勝平$$
「Shut up! Why do you just decide that the people of Earth have evil thoughts?!」

647:t_005:12.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「This is no assumption. We have continually observed the planet called Earth in every world.」

647:t_005:13.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「We have done so for an immense span of time beyond your imagining.」

647:t_005:14.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「And we have reached a conclusion: Earthlings are evil beings.」

647:t_005:15.en:
$$葵$$
「One-sided logic, shutting down objections, completely groundless assumptions... It's typical of a machine that's all brains and no sense.」

647:t_005:16.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「You cannot understand our words...? That cannot be helped.」

647:t_005:17.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「But we will not permit your expansion into the galaxy... your evolution.」

647:t_005:18.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Don't talk like the $$御使い$$s, you clay-doll bastard!」

647:t_005:19.en:
$$勝平$$
「I won't let your words confuse me anymore! I'll fight to protect Earth... to protect everyone!」

647:t_005:20.en:
$$勝平$$
「You only see the bad in people and refuse to acknowledge the good! You're the ones who should disappear from this universe!」

647:t_005:21.en:
$$勝平$$
「We're going to live! If anyone won't let us, we'll fight them with everything we've got!」

647:t_006:0.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Your courage has called me here!」

647:t_006:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$ゼウス$$! You came for us!」

647:t_006:2.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「I have awaited this day, younger brothers! You have at last walked the path of evolution and taken your first step into $$シンカ$$!」

647:t_006:3.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Now is the time for us to fight together! I, $$ゼウス$$, pledge my life to stand with you!」

647:t_006:4.en:
$$勝平$$
「Heh... It's weird. He's saying the same kind of stuff as that $$ミケーネ$$ bastard, but this really hits me right in the gut.」

647:t_006:5.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Of course it does! Uncle $$ゼウス$$ has been on our side for ages!」

647:t_006:6.en:
$$號$$
「He has never coddled us, but has always encouraged us and shown us the way...」

647:t_006:7.en:
$$甲児$$
「Now I get it, $$ゼウス$$. You were trying to fulfill the mission of a higher-dimensional life-form.」

647:t_006:8.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「I myself feel that it was presumptuous of me...」

647:t_006:9.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「But you overcame those trials, arrogant though they may have been, and have now stepped out into the galaxy!」

647:t_006:10.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Now let me honor your strength, your spirit! And your growth!」

647:t_006:12.en:
$$竜馬$$
「But it's still too soon to praise us.」

647:t_006:13.en:
$$赤木$$
「We're about to overcome the villains blocking our way!」

647:t_006:14.en:
$$勝平$$
「$$ガイゾック$$! If you've all come out together, that suits me just fine! I'll settle things with you right here!」

647:t_003:12: Takeru states the condition about losing peace and freedom; Koji supplies the defiant consequence in t_003:13.
